query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fraud_rules" (
  "id" text PRIMARY KEY,
  "merchant_id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "condition_tree" text NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  "actions" text NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  "priority" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
  "status" text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  "hit_count" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "last_hit_at" timestamp,
  "created_by" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp DEFAULT now() NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "fraud_rule_merchant_idx" ON "fraud_rules" ("merchant_id");
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "fraud_rule_status_idx" ON "fraud_rules" ("merchant_id", "status");

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "kyb_documents" (
  "id" text PRIMARY KEY,
  "verification_id" text NOT NULL,
  "merchant_id" text NOT NULL,
  "document_type" text NOT NULL,
  "file_name" text NOT NULL,
  "file_key" text NOT NULL,
  "file_url" text NOT NULL,
  "mime_type" text NOT NULL,
  "file_size_bytes" integer NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  "review_notes" text,
  "reviewed_by" text,
  "reviewed_at" timestamp,
  "uploaded_by" text NOT NULL,
  "uploaded_at" timestamp DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp DEFAULT now() NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "kyb_doc_verification_idx" ON "kyb_documents" ("verification_id");
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "kyb_doc_merchant_idx" ON "kyb_documents" ("merchant_id");

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "loyalty_v3_redemptions" (
  "id" text PRIMARY KEY,
  "program_id" text NOT NULL,
  "member_id" text NOT NULL,
  "merchant_id" text NOT NULL,
  "customer_id" text NOT NULL,
  "reward_tier" text NOT NULL,
  "points_redeemed" integer NOT NULL,
  "points_balance_before" integer NOT NULL,
  "points_balance_after" integer NOT NULL,
  "naira_value" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "redemption_code" text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  "pin_verified" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "kafka_event_id" text,
  "kafka_event_status" text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  "status" text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  "expires_at" timestamp NOT NULL,
  "confirmed_at" timestamp,
  "fulfilled_at" timestamp,
  "notes" text,
  "created_at" timestamp DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp DEFAULT now() NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "loyalty_v3_redemption_program_idx" ON "loyalty_v3_redemptions" ("program_id");
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "loyalty_v3_redemption_member_idx" ON "loyalty_v3_redemptions" ("member_id");
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "loyalty_v3_redemption_merchant_idx" ON "loyalty_v3_redemptions" ("merchant_id");
